# healthrun

[![Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/healthcheck/healthrun.svg)](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/healthcheck/healthrun)

Package healthrun runs dependency probes concurrently and reports the outcome of
each one, without any transport dependency.

It defines the check model shared by the health endpoints of this library:
  - [HealthChecker]: check contract (`HealthCheck(context.Context) error`),
    with `HealthCheckFunc` to adapt a plain function
  - [HealthCheck]: ID + checker registration unit
  - [Runner]: runs the checks in parallel and returns their outcomes keyed by
    check ID

[healthcheck](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/healthcheck) serves the outcomes over HTTP
and [grpcserver](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/grpcserver) over the gRPC health service.
The healthcheck types are aliases of the types of this package, so the same
checks can be registered with both.

## Run Semantics

  - checks execute in parallel, one goroutine per check
  - a checker panic is recovered, logged, and reported as `ErrCheckPanic`
  - a nil checker is reported as `ErrNoChecker`
  - with `WithTimeout`, checks that overrun are reported as `ErrCheckTimeout`

Check IDs should be unique and non-empty: outcomes are keyed by ID, so duplicate
or empty IDs collapse into a single entry (a warning is logged at construction).

## When To Use

  - A non-HTTP transport must report the status of several dependencies.
  - A service must avoid the HTTP dependencies of pkg/healthcheck.

## Example

```go
checks := []healthrun.HealthCheck{
	healthrun.New("database", healthrun.HealthCheckFunc(func(_ context.Context) error {
		return errors.New("connection refused")
	})),
	healthrun.New("cache", healthrun.HealthCheckFunc(func(_ context.Context) error {
		return nil
	})),
}

runner := healthrun.NewRunner(checks, healthrun.WithTimeout(time.Second))

results := runner.Run(context.TODO())

fmt.Println(results["cache"])
fmt.Println(results["database"])

// Output:
// <nil>
// connection refused
```

Full source is in [example_healthrun_test.go](example_healthrun_test.go).
More runnable examples are on [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/tecnickcom/nurago/pkg/healthcheck/healthrun#pkg-examples).

## Dependencies

This package reaches no external module: it uses only the Go standard library.
